Members

LOCAL_GROUP

Local Group dwarf + satellite galaxies — the ~30 small members that orbit the Milky Way and Andromeda, placed at real galactic (l, b, distance) through gpos. Milky Way satellites inside ~1 Mly stay on the honest galactic tier (LMC ~1 630, SagDEG ~810 units); the M31 subgroup and the scattered dIrrs land on the Local-Group tier beyond ~10k units. Drawn as seeded elliptical point smudges — warm for the old-population spheroidals, cool for the star-forming irregulars.
